pair.no_devices: No appliances found yet. Open the app settings and run the one-time Home Connect login first.
pair.no_devices_of_type: None of your stored appliances is recognised as a {{type}}. Found: {{types}}. If one of these is a {{type}}, please report it with a diagnostics report.

error.no_keys: No local keys found for this appliance. Re-pair the app.
error.unreachable: Appliance is unreachable on the local network.
error.unknown_program: That program is not valid for this appliance.
error.remote_start_not_allowed: Remote start is not enabled on the appliance. Enable it on the appliance first.
error.feature_not_supported: This appliance does not support that setting.
error.feature_not_available: That setting is not currently available on the appliance.
error.door_open: The door is open. Close the door before starting a program.
error.no_selected_program: No program is selected on the appliance. Select one on the appliance (or with the 'Select a program' card) first.
error.powered_off: The coffee machine is off. Turn it on first and wait until it has finished rinsing.

unavailable.resolve_failed: Homey can't find the appliance on the network. Check that it is switched on and connected to the same network as Homey.
unavailable.connect_timeout: The appliance doesn't answer. Check that it is switched on and on the same network as Homey, not a guest or IoT network.
unavailable.connection_refused: The appliance refused the connection. Its address may have changed; the app keeps looking for it.
unavailable.host_unreachable: Homey can't reach the appliance's network. Is the appliance on another network or VLAN?
unavailable.tls_failed: The appliance didn't accept the security key. Refresh the appliances in the app settings.
unavailable.ws_rejected: The appliance refused the connection. It may already be connected to another controller, such as a second Homey.
unavailable.closed_by_appliance: The appliance closed the connection. If it is also added to another Homey or controller, remove it there.
unavailable.unknown: Appliance is unreachable on the local network.

settings.title: Home Connect
settings.login_step_generate: Create the login link and open it in Chrome or Edge on your computer.
settings.login_step_signin: Before logging in, open the developer tools in that tab (F12, on a Mac fn+F12), go to the Network tab and tick Preserve log. Then log in with your SingleKey ID. The page hangs or shows an error afterwards; this is expected.
settings.login_step_paste: Type hcauth in the filter, copy the Request URL (it starts with hcauth://) and paste it below.
settings.import_hint: Already have a devices.json, for example from hcpy? Paste its contents or choose a file.
settings.no_devices: No appliances yet. Log in or import a devices.json.
settings.refresh_hint: Fetches the appliance list again with the saved account details, for example after adding an appliance to your Home Connect account.
settings.done_found: __count__ appliance(s) found and saved. Add them via Add device > Home Connect.
settings.import_done: __count__ appliance(s) imported. Add them via Add device > Home Connect.
settings.copy_manually: Select and copy the link manually.
settings.import_empty: Paste or choose a devices.json first.
settings.clear_done: All saved appliances and the session have been cleared.
settings.progress_lookup: Looking up your Home Connect account...
settings.lead_setup: Local control needs the key of each appliance. They are retrieved once through your Home Connect account. After that, all communication stays local, without a cloud connection.
settings.lead_devices: Your appliances are controlled over your local network. Add new appliances via Add device > Home Connect.
settings.mobile_note: Pairing is not possible on a phone or tablet. Open this page on a computer via my.homey.app > Apps > Home Connect.
settings.method_login_body: Works with Chrome or Edge on a computer. After logging in, you copy one address from the developer tools.
settings.method_import_body: Create the file with the homeconnect-profile-downloader for Windows, Mac or Linux and choose the hcpy profile.
settings.docs_subtitle: Pairing, connection problems and supported appliances
settings.not_added_hint: Available to add via Add device > Home Connect.
settings.unsupported_hint: Support for this appliance type is planned for a later version.
settings.mdns_never: Not seen since the app started
